items.claim: Stan Dorsonville is taking this UFC opportunity on short notice with less than 10 pro fights.
items.quote: Dorsonville who has to take a UFC opportunity on short notice, who has had less than 10 pro fights

items.claim: Jackson McVey and Wes Schultz previously fought on the amateur scene where Schultz submitted McVey.
items.quote: these guys actually fought back on the amateur scene and Schultz submitted McVey.

items.claim: Wes Schultz's takedowns, kicks, and punches lack power.
items.quote: his takedowns don't have much on them. His kicks don't have much on them, his punches don't have much on them.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer will use her length advantage to keep Elise Reed on the outside with her jab.
items.quote: Dyer is going to use that length advantage, keep Reed on the outside of her jab, and just pick her apart the entire time.

items.claim: Elise Reed lacks the fight-changing power that Carl Fro possessed against Chanel Dyer.
items.quote: we simply cannot say the same thing about Elise Reed.

items.claim: Mason Jones is on a seven-fight win streak with an 18-2 professional record.
items.quote: this guy's 18 and two as a pro. He's on a seven fight win streak
